recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of six men in opulent 1980s fashion, arranged in a tight triangular formation against a soft, gradient studio backdrop. The composition is anchored by a large, bold serif title at the top and a thin horizontal rule separating the primary and secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight grouping of subjects creating a unified central mass
Contrast between heavy textures like fur and the smooth gradient background
Dominant red typography against a cool-toned blue/grey environment
Hierarchy established by the seated central figure and standing outer figures
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused studio lighting with gentle shadows
Horizontal rule line under the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centrally located, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame in a tiered arrangement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The seated figure in the foreground and the large red title at the top act as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold red title, moves down through the faces of the standing men, and rests on the seated figure at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right sides of the group, with a soft vignette effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool grey-blue background providing a neutral stage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and browns from the clothing providing weight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red used for the main title and specific clothing details (boots, shirts).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red accents against a desaturated, medium-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, denim blue, and primary red

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with some character overlap
Dramatic difference between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' and 'B' are slightly oversized to frame the word grouping

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the background, clear of the subjects' heads

composition.position: Directly below the main title, under a thin rule

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast: Heavy, tight serif paired with light, wide sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule line separating text levels

avoid: Modernist geometric sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy weight and tight spacing of the era's display serifs
Alternative for a heavy, rounded vintage feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a six-man ensemble in 1980s luxury fashion (fur coats, denim, gold jewelry) arranged in a tiered triangle. Use a soft blue-grey gradient background with a subtle floor line. Leave the top 20% of the frame empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold red serif title in the top center with negative tracking. Place a thin black horizontal line below it, followed by a wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle in all caps.

verificationChecks: Is the main title red and high-contrast?
Is there a horizontal rule between the two text elements?
Are the subjects arranged in a triangular formation?
Is the background a soft, cool-toned gradient?

adjustableVariables: Background color (can shift to warm tan or deep green)
Clothing textures (fur vs. leather vs. silk)
Text color (can shift to gold or white)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red title is the most saturated element
Verify the horizontal rule is perfectly straight
Confirm the background is a smooth, noise-free gradient
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble portrait + triangular composition + high-contrast serif display type + horizontal rule separator.
